title: Dairy consumption and risk of type 2 diabetes: 3 cohorts of US adults and an updated meta-analysis
authors: Chen M, Sun Q, Giovannucci E, Mozaffarian D, Manson JE, Willett WC, et al.
population: Health Professionals Follow-up Study, Nurses' Health Study and Nurses' Health Study II; meta-analysis of 14 prospective cohorts with 459,790 participants
funder: National Institutes of Health grants DK58845, P01 CA87969, P01 CA055075, R01 HL034594 and HL60712; NHLBI career development award R00HL098459. The funders had no role in study design, data collection and analysis, decision to publish, or preparation of the manuscript.
authorConflicts: D Mozaffarian declared membership of the Unilever North America Scientific Advisory Board.
result: 15,156 incident type 2 diabetes cases in 3,984,203 person-years. Per serving/day: total dairy HR 0.99 (95% CI 0.98 to 1.01); yogurt 0.83 (0.75 to 0.92). Meta-analysis of 14 cohorts (35,863 cases): total dairy RR 0.98 (0.96 to 1.01) and yogurt 0.82 (0.70 to 0.96) per serving/day.
